full_judgment: 3. Alhaj Sheikh Mohammed Noor, father of the respondent herein, purchased 30.50 acres of land from the S. A. recorded owner. After purchase, he has been possessing the same. The predecessor-in-interest of the respondent being the owner and possessor of the case land muted his name in the concerned office of the Assistant Commissioner (Land) and paid rent by obtaining rent receipts and duplicate carbon receipts (D.C.R). The respondent has been paying rent of the case land in the name of her predecessor whose name was duly recorded in the R. S. Khatian of the case land.
